$comment: Layout grid in CSS pixels / native points. Edges and sizes are on the 4 pt grid; centers are derived. Menus retain schemas/menu-metrics/menu-metrics.json. Comfortable icon boxes apply only to sidebar and Home lists. Formula terms are token names multiplied by their coefficients. CSS lengths marked scaled follow --cmux-interface-scale; native lengths are unscaled points.
